statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0440 is an informational notice that astral-tokio-tar is unmaintained, not a specific security vulnerability. Astral ended maintenance of the crate on November 3, 2026, and all versions are deprecated; no patched release exists. In uv, the uv-extract crate uses it to extract tar archives. Upstream recommends tar-codec as a replacement; migrating uv to a different tar implementation is an upstream dependency change and remains under evaluation.

Upstream recommends tar-codec as a replacement; migrating uv to a different tar implementation is an upstream dependency change and remains under evaluation.

NiFi ships the prebuilt uv binary from astral-sh/uv release 0.13.7 at /home/nifi/.local/bin/uv, which embeds astral-tokio-tar 0.7.0. RUSTSEC-2026-0440 is an unmaintained advisory: Astral ended maintenance of astral-tokio-tar on November 3, 2026, and the advisory lists no patched versions. uv 0.13.7 is the latest upstream release and still pins astral-tokio-tar 0.7.0, so there is no fixed uv release to adopt. Waiting for a uv release that replaces astral-tokio-tar.
